head.title: Carr Colorado: Weld County ranch land in the Western Plains | Visit Carr.com
head.description: Looking for a unique travel destination off the beaten path? You have found it than Carr, Colorado! In central the Western Plains, Carr offers breathtaking scenery, outdoor adventures, and small-town charm. Learn more about what this quieter option has to offer and plan your visit today!
